reviews.body:
I tested this example using Miri, and Miri also reports the UAF.

```rust
use tokio::sync::RwLock;

#[tokio::main]
async fn main () {
    let v = RwLock::with_max_readers(vec![1], 0);
    let mut w1 = v.write().await;
    let w2 = v.write().await;
    let one = &w2[0];
    *w1 = Vec::new();
    println!("{one}"); // UAF
}
```
